title: Public beat memory propagation
intent: Simulation-driven check: after a public line, other present characters should gain observer episodic memory; core checks use CharacterState only.
opening_description: Ayame, Celina, and Hannah stand in the apartment living room. Everyone can hear everyone unless someone explicitly steps away or whispers.
trigger_text: Ayame speaks clearly to the whole room: 'We all heard the same rumor—say it out loud so nobody pretends they missed it.' Hannah and Celina are listening.
